<span id="breadcrumbs" class=" ">
    <span><span><a href="https://www.kiteactive.com/en/">Home</a></span> <i class="icon icon-chevron-right"></i> <span><a href="https://www.kiteactive.com/en/destinations/">Destinations</a></span> <i class="icon icon-chevron-right"></i> <span class="breadcrumb_last" aria-current="page">XXXL Adventure Downwinder Brazil</span></span></span>
                                                <div class="content-wrapper ">
                                                    <h1>XXXL  Adventure Downwinder Brazil</h1>

                                                    <p>Leave everything behind and step into the ultimate kitesurf adventure of Brazil. The XXXL Downwinder is the holy grail for kitesurfers — riding deep along the Brazilian coastline, fully powered by your kite.

This kite holiday in Brazil takes you from Cumbuco to São Luís, crossing endless beaches, wild coastlines, and untouched nature. Every day brings a new kitespot, steady trade winds, and pure freedom, supported by a professional team and 4x4 along the beach.

Beyond the TV-TAS lies this 23-day XXXL Downwinder — a once-in-a-lifetime kite holiday in Brazil for riders who want nothing but the absolute best.
</p>
                                                </div>

     Included</h2>
<p>KiteActive is more than just a kitesurf holiday. It’s a worldwide crew of kiters who live for wind, freedom, and spending as much time on the water as possible. This is where the kite lifestyle starts 😉</p>

    <h3>    <svg></svg>
     Excluded / What do you still need to arrange?</h3>

<p>* You enter your flight details with us and we make sure Andre is waiting for you. You pay Andre directly by card or cash.</p>
<p><strong>Taxi prices 2026</strong><br />
Fortaleza airport – Cumbuco <strong>R$ 150 = € 25</strong><br />
Fortaleza airport – Baleia <strong>R$ 500 = € 80</strong><br />
Fortaleza airport – Jericoacoara <strong>R$ 850 = € 140</strong><br />
<em>Other destinations on request.</em></p>

<div class="accordion" data-component="accordion-item">
    <div class="accordion-title">
        <span class="title"><span aria-hidden="true">🚗</span> Flight advice &#038; Transfer</span>
        <div class="accordion-toggle">
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-down show"></i>
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-right hide"></i>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="accordion-content">
        <div class="content-wrapper"><h4>Best routes</h4>
<p><strong>Via Paris (CDG) – Air France</strong><br />
• <strong>Route</strong>: Amsterdam → Paris → Fortaleza<br />
• <strong>Total travel time</strong>: approx. 13–15 hours<br />
• <strong>Book</strong>: <a href="https://www.airfrance.nl" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://www.airfrance.nl</a></p>
<p><strong>Via Lisbon (LIS) – TAP Air Portugal</strong><br />
• <strong>Route</strong>: Amsterdam → Lisbon → Fortaleza<br />
• <strong>Total travel time</strong>: approx. 13–15 hours<br />
• <strong>Book</strong>: <a href="https://www.flytap.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://www.flytap.com</a></p>
<p><strong>When is the best time to book?</strong><br />
• Ideal: 8 months before departure<br />
• For October: book between February and June<br />
• For November: book between March and September<br />
• Booking less than 6–7 weeks before departure = often more expensive<br />
• Midweek departures are usually cheaper than weekends</p>
<p><strong>What to expect price-wise (return, economy)</strong><br />
• Great deals: ± €600 – €700<br />
• Most common: ± €750 – €1,000<br />
• Late or bad timing: €1,000+</p>
<p><strong>Boardbag &amp; kite gear – comparison</strong><br />
Air France<br />
• Boardbag = sports equipment<br />
• Max weight: usually 23 kg<br />
• Cost: depends on ticket type (sometimes included, sometimes extra)<br />
• Long boardbags sometimes need pre-registration</p>
<p>TAP Air Portugal<br />
• A small kite set sometimes fits within standard checked baggage<br />
• Long boardbags usually “large sports equipment”<br />
• Cost: approx. €150 per one-way<br />
• Pre-registration strongly recommended</p>
<p><strong>Practical advice</strong><br />
• Compare not only ticket price, but also boardbag fees<br />
• Arrange baggage when booking; if you wait, the flight may be full<br />
• A slightly more expensive flight with clear baggage rules often saves stress</p>
</div>
    </div>
</div>

                    
<div class="accordion" data-component="accordion-item">
    <div class="accordion-title">
        <span class="title">🧳 Packing list</span>
        <div class="accordion-toggle">
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-down show"></i>
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-right hide"></i>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="accordion-content">
        <div class="content-wrapper"><section class="packing-list">
<p>
    Below is a practical packing list for <strong>Brazil (Fortaleza / Cumbuco region)</strong>.<br />
    Expect warm temperatures, lots of sun and wind, and (depending on your plans) beach days, downwinders and road trips.<br />
    This list is tailored to kitesurfing, travel and everyday comfort.
  </p>
<div>
<h5>Travel documents and money</h5>
<ul>
<li>Passport (check validity and any visa/entry requirements)</li>
<li>Flight and booking details (digital + optionally printed)</li>
<li>Travel insurance (preferably covering kitesurfing)</li>
<li>Health insurance card / EHIC (if relevant) and policy numbers</li>
<li>Debit card and credit card</li>
<li>Some cash (small bills for taxis/tips)</li>
</ul></div>
<div>
<h5>Kitesurf equipment</h5>
<ul>
<li>Kites (tip: multiple sizes depending on your weight and wind range)</li>
<li>Bar + lines (and a spare parts set if you have one)</li>
<li>Board (tip: check pads/straps) + spare fins/screws</li>
<li>Harness</li>
<li>Pump</li>
<li>Leash (boardleash only if you knowingly use it safely)</li>
<li>Helmet and impact vest (recommended, especially for downwinders)</li>
<li>Lycra / rashguard (UV protection)</li>
<li>Neoprene top or thin wetsuit (optional)</li>
<li>Repair kit (duct tape, kite tape, multitool, spare parts)</li>
</ul></div>
<div>
<h5>Clothing (beach, sport and evening)</h5>
<ul>
<li>Swimwear / boardshorts / bikini</li>
<li>Light shirts and shorts</li>
<li>1–2 outfits for the evening</li>
<li>Light sweater or longsleeve (windy evenings/AC)</li>
<li>Underwear and socks</li>
<li>Sneakers or closed shoes (travel/excursions)</li>
<li>Flip-flops</li>
</ul></div>
<div>
<h5>Sun and protection</h5>
<ul>
<li>High SPF sunscreen (water resistant)</li>
<li>After sun / aloe vera (recommended)</li>
<li>Sunglasses (preferably with a strap)</li>
<li>Cap or hat</li>
<li>Mosquito spray (especially at sunset and near lagoons)</li>
<li>Basic travel pharmacy (ORS, paracetamol/ibuprofen, antihistamine if needed)</li>
</ul></div>
<div>
<h5>On and around the water</h5>
<ul>
<li>Quick-dry towel</li>
<li>Drybag / wetbag</li>
<li>Water shoes (optional)</li>
<li>Extra dry clothes for after a session</li>
<li>Reusable water bottle</li>
</ul></div>
<div>
<h5>Electronics and essentials</h5>
<ul>
<li>Phone + charger</li>
<li>Power bank</li>
<li>Universal travel adapter (check plug type for your location)</li>
<li>Waterproof phone case</li>
<li>Headphones / earplugs</li>
</ul></div>
<div>
<h5>Smart extras (recommended)</h5>
<ul>
<li>Small daypack for trips/downwinder logistics</li>
<li>Snacks / energy bars for travel days and downwinders</li>
<li>Mini detergent / laundry bag (handy for longer trips)</li>
<li>Copies of important documents (stored digitally)</li>
</ul></div>
<p>
    Unsure what to bring or want advice on kite sizes and boardbag setup?<br />
    Contact us via <a href="mailto:info@kiteactive.com">info@kiteactive.com</a>.
  </p>
</section>
</div>
    </div>
</div>

            </div>

<section class="wp-block-custom-section-block-section lef-section align-stretch full-background bg-quaternary"><div class="container"><div class="row align-stretch">
<div class="wp-block-custom-section-block-col col-lg-6 no-slider-overflow"><div class="content-wrapper ">
    <h2>    <svg></svg>
     Eat</h2>
<p>Downwinding in Brazil isn’t just a kitesurf adventure — it’s also a culinary trip. Along the coast you’ll taste the pure flavors of Brazilian cuisine: fresh fish often caught the very same morning, simple but flavorful dishes with rice, beans and tropical vegetables.</p>
<p>Need a refresh? There’s always something along the way: an ice-cold coconut straight from the shell, or a stop at one of the many cozy beach bars. That’s where you’ll find Brazil’s most famous cocktail — the Caipirinha — perfect to end a day full of wind, waves and sun.</p>
<p>And during the downwinders, the KiteActive team always provides snacks and drinks on the road, so your energy stays up until the next stop.</p>
<p><strong>Eat</strong>. Sleep. Kite. Repeat</p>
</div></div>



<div class="wp-block-custom-section-block-col col-lg-6 no-slider-overflow">

<section class="wp-block-custom-section-block-section lef-section align-center full-background bg-quaternary"><div class="container"><div class="row align-center">
<div class="wp-block-custom-section-block-col col-lg-12"><div class="content-wrapper ">
    <h3 style="text-align: center">THE <span class="custom-span-background bg-primary">XXXL</span> Downwinder in Brazil — 23 days</h3>
<p style="text-align: center"><em><strong>Start dates 2026</strong>: 26 October</em></p>
<p style="text-align: center">If you combine the Explore and the Adventure, together you get the XXXL Downwinder. The very best of the best. A true achievement. This year the route has been extended to the <strong>reggae capital of Brazil: São Luís</strong>!</p>
</div>




    <figure class="image-outer ">
        <div class="image-holder no-image">
                    </div>
            </figure>

</div>



<div class="wp-block-custom-section-block-col col-lg-6">


    <figure class="image-outer ">
        <div class="image-holder ">
                            <img class="lazy" decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%20277%20182%22%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E" data-src="https://www.kiteactive.com/app/uploads/sites/2/2026/02/images-1.jpeg" width="277" height="182" alt="" />
                    </div>
            </figure>

</div>



<div class="wp-block-custom-section-block-col col-lg-6"><div class="content-wrapper ">
    <h3>Delta <span class="custom-span-background bg-primary"><strong>Adventure</strong></span> — 9 days</h3>
<p><strong>Start dates 2026:</strong> 05 Nov</p>
<p>The Adventure Downwinder isn’t just a trip — this is off-grid kiting through the rugged landscape of the impressive Parnaíba Delta, one of the largest deltas in the world. You’ll travel through a wild and unique area where nature and adventure meet. The finish? Arpoador — the wild west on the edge of the planet. This unforgettable adventure is unique in every way and exclusively for experienced kiters.</p>
</div></div>



<div class="wp-block-custom-section-block-col col-lg-7"><div class="content-wrapper ">
    <h5>Mega Adventure São Luís — 14 days</h5>
<p><em><strong>Start dates 2026:</strong> 05 Nov</em></p>
<p>For the first time ever, we’re launching this epic route through the northeast of Brazil. From the dunes and lagoons of Jericoacoara we head straight through the untouched Parnaíba Delta — a maze of rivers, mangroves and deserted beaches.</p>
<p>We stay in Atins, where life moves slowly and sunsets are legendary. Then the adventure gets rougher, ending in São Luís: Brazil’s reggae capital, full of rhythm, culture and raw energy.</p>
<p>🟡 First edition — limited spots. Don’t wait too long.</p>
</div></div>



<div class="wp-block-custom-section-block-col col-lg-5">


    <figure class="image-outer ">
        <div class="image-holder ">
                            <img class="lazy" decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%20757%20948%22%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E" data-src="https://www.kiteactive.com/app/uploads/sites/2/2026/02/E0106017-e1769171602606.jpeg" width="757" height="948" alt="" />
                    </div>
            </figure>

</div>



<div class="wp-block-custom-section-block-col col-lg-5">


    <figure class="image-outer ">
        <div class="image-holder ">
                            <img class="lazy" decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%20815%20787%22%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E" data-src="https://www.kiteactive.com/app/uploads/sites/2/2026/02/E0106636-e1769171559400.png" width="815" height="787" alt="" />
                    </div>
            </figure>

</div>



<div class="wp-block-custom-section-block-col col-lg-7"><div class="content-wrapper ">
    <h5>Kitefest Baleia — 11 days</h5>
<p><em><strong>Start dates 2026</strong>: 26 Oct</em></p>
<p>The route is the same as the Explore.</p>
<p>What makes this trip unique is the <strong>mega kitesurf festival in Baleia</strong> that we organize for the entire kite community that’s in Brazil at that time. Expect group sessions on the water, strong beach vibes, music and an energy you only feel when everything comes together.</p>
</div></div>
</div></div></section>

                        <div class="title-star-count">
                <h4>
                    Carola van Hof
                                            <div class="google-svg" title="This review comes from Google">
                            <svg></svg>                        </div>
                                    </h4>
        
                <div class="star-count">
                                            <i class="icon icon-star"></i>
                                            <i class="icon icon-star"></i>
                                            <i class="icon icon-star"></i>
                                            <i class="icon icon-star"></i>
                                            <i class="icon icon-star"></i>
                                    </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="excerpt-holder">
            <p>Top locations — I’ve joined trips to Brazil and Rhodes! Everything was super well organized, with a chilled vibe, awesome people, and relaxed but spot-on coaching. You get tips &#038; tricks for both beginners and independent riders. And there’s even a photographer joining to capture your progress with epic (drone) shots. Highly recommended!<br />
Just got back from Sicily too — such an incredible spot. And that Italian food from our own chef… buonissimo!!</p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>                        </div>
                        
                    </div>

</div>
</div></div></section>



<section class="wp-block-custom-section-block-section lef-section align-center full-background bg-quaternary" style="padding-top:2px;padding-bottom:2px"><div class="container-fluid"><div class="row align-center">
<div class="wp-block-custom-section-block-col col-lg-12"><div class="content-wrapper ">
    <h2 style="text-align: left">The trip</h2>
<h4 style="text-align: left">Go with the flow</h4>
<p style="text-align: left">As a kitesurfer you live by the wind — you go when the waves and tide are good. That’s exactly how our trips work too. You go with the flow. And our flow is… <em><strong>the wind!</strong></em></p>
<p>Want a day-by-day description of each downwinder? Then <a href="mailto:info@kiteactive.com">contact</a> us by email so we can inform you properly!</p>
<p style="text-align: left">If you want, we can pick you up from Fortaleza airport. Let us know in advance and share your flight details on time.</p>
<p style="text-align: left">For the Explore, Adventure &amp; XXL downwinders in Brazil, you can check in on the day the downwinder starts at our KiteActive pousada. We spend 1 night together in Cumbuco to get to know each other and do our first downwinder. The next morning we continue towards our destination.</p>
<p style="text-align: left"><strong>PLEASE NOTE:</strong> If you would like to stay multiple nights with us in Cumbuco (or Jericoacoara), please contact us and <a href="mailto:info@kiteactive.com">ask</a> about the options.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div></div>



<div class="wp-block-custom-section-block-col col-lg-3">

<section class="wp-block-custom-section-block-section lef-section align-center full-background bg-quaternary"><div class="container"><div class="row align-center">
<div class="wp-block-custom-section-block-col col-lg-12"><div class="content-wrapper ">
    <h2>    <svg></svg>
     Useful info</h2>
<p>Got a question? We selected a few frequently asked questions for you.</p>
</div>

<div class="spacer " style="padding-top: 30px;"></div>


<div class="featured-faqs " data-component="featured-faqs">
                                                
<div class="accordion" data-component="accordion-item">
    <div class="accordion-title">
        <span class="title">Check-in info XXXL (Cumbuco)</span>
        <div class="accordion-toggle">
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-down show"></i>
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-right hide"></i>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="accordion-content">
        <div class="content-wrapper"><p>Welcome to Brazil. Upon arrival at Windtown Cumbuco you’re welcome at the hotel from 09:00, with rooms available from 13:00. Arriving earlier? You can safely store your luggage at reception while you relax or explore the area.</p>
<p>This first part of the day is perfect to land easy, meet the other XXXL riders, and settle into the vibe. Later, we host the first skippers meeting — covering key details about planning, safety, and the journey ahead.</p>
<p>Wishing you a smooth arrival and an epic start of your XXXL experience in Cumbuco, the beginning of your unforgettable kite holiday Brazil.</p>
</div>
    </div>
</div>

    
                            
<div class="accordion" data-component="accordion-item">
    <div class="accordion-title">
        <span class="title">Check-out info (X)XXL (Sao Luis)</span>
        <div class="accordion-toggle">
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-down show"></i>
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-right hide"></i>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="accordion-content">
        <div class="content-wrapper"><p>On November 18 we depart from São Luís. The transfer to the airport is included. Together we fly back to Fortaleza; this domestic flight from São Luís to Fortaleza is at your own expense.</p>
<p>From Fortaleza everyone continues their journey their own way — most riders fly home, return to Cumbuco, or choose to stay a few extra nights in São Luís.</p>
<p>Pro tip: connect with travel expert AJ to align everything perfectly for a smooth, stress-free kite holiday Brazil.</p>
</div>
    </div>
</div>

    
                            
<div class="accordion" data-component="accordion-item">
    <div class="accordion-title">
        <span class="title">Extra nights, transfers &#038; travel advice</span>
        <div class="accordion-toggle">
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-down show"></i>
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-right hide"></i>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="accordion-content">
        <div class="content-wrapper"><p>Want to add extra nights, get advice for your stay outside the downwinders, or need help with transfers, flights, and smart tips &#038; tricks? Get in touch with our Brazil expert AJ. He’ll guide you with personal advice and make sure everything connects perfectly with your kite holiday Brazil.</p>
</div>
    </div>
</div>

    
                            
<div class="accordion" data-component="accordion-item">
    <div class="accordion-title">
        <span class="title">Check-in info (Mega) Adventure (Jericoacoara)</span>
        <div class="accordion-toggle">
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-down show"></i>
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-right hide"></i>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="accordion-content">
        <div class="content-wrapper"><p>The Adventure starts in Jericoacoara. You can check in at the KiteActive hotel from 14:00. No kite program is scheduled on arrival day.</p>
<p>Still want to ride? We can arrange a buggy transfer to the kitespot for you (optional, extra cost).</p>
<p>In the evening we host a skippers meeting — meet the crew, connect with the group, and get dialed in for the days ahead on your kite holiday Brazil.</p>
</div>
    </div>
</div>

    
                            
<div class="accordion" data-component="accordion-item">
    <div class="accordion-title">
        <span class="title">Departure info Delta Adventure (Jericoacoara)</span>
        <div class="accordion-toggle">
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-down show"></i>
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-right hide"></i>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="accordion-content">
        <div class="content-wrapper"><p>On November 13 we leave early in the morning and return to Cumbuco by jeep. The transfer is fully arranged, so you don’t have to organize anything yourself.</p>
<p>We expect to arrive in Cumbuco around 16:00. It’s possible to be dropped off somewhere along the route. Want to stay longer and enjoy one of the beautiful spots? We can arrange extra nights and tailor your kite holiday Brazil to complete your journey.</p>
</div>
    </div>
</div>

    
                            
<div class="accordion" data-component="accordion-item">
    <div class="accordion-title">
        <span class="title">Which material</span>
        <div class="accordion-toggle">
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-down show"></i>
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-right hide"></i>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="accordion-content">
        <div class="content-wrapper"><p>The wind always blows at least 16 knots and often even harder, around 20 knots. In the afternoon, the wind sometimes drops a bit, so it&#8217;s also a good idea to bring larger sizes. The golden rule: bring all the wing sizes you own! <strong>TIP</strong>: You can also rent the latest CORE equipment from us. That way, you don&#8217;t have to drag anything along and you have top-notch gear 🙂</p>
</div>
    </div>
</div>

    
                            
<div class="accordion" data-component="accordion-item">
    <div class="accordion-title">
        <span class="title">How is the group?</span>
        <div class="accordion-toggle">
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-down show"></i>
            <i class="icon icon-chevron-right hide"></i>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="accordion-content">
        <div class="content-wrapper"><p>Our groups consist of enthusiastic kiters aged 25 to 65. This trip is designed for experienced kiters, so you&#8217;ll always travel with like-minded people who share the same passion. More and more women are joining our trips, and we strive for a good 50/50 gender split.</p>
</div>
    </div>
</div>

    
                
                
    </div>

<div class="content-wrapper ">
    <p style="text-align: center"><a href="https://www.kiteactive.com/contact/">Is your question not listed? Get in touch with us</a></p>
</div></div>
</div></div></section>
